caution_notes: May lower blood sugar - caution with antidiabetic medicines; caution in autoimmune disease
Avoid in exhaustion, dehydration and after fasting (classical caution)
Caution with thyroid medicines and sedatives
Long-term use may raise blood pressure and cause oedema - caution in hypertension
Caution in gallstones and with anticoagulant medicines (concentrated extracts)
Neem oil is unsafe for infants and small children
Caution with heart and blood-pressure medicines
Leaf latex (aloin) is a strong purgative
May lower blood sugar - caution with antidiabetic medicines; caution in pregnancy in medicinal doses
Caution with anticoagulant medicines and before surgery
